dataset.title: LOC FAQ v0.5 Current Overlay
dataset.purpose: Project Current terminology and semantics into FAQ retrieval while excluding deprecated numbered-architecture questions from the Current index.

migration_policy.km_policy: KM means Knowledge Management. FAQ, RAG, Search and Graph traversal are views/features/derivatives, not KM itself.

FAQ-002.answer: LOC／月典是 Modular Language Framework／模組化語言框架；LunaRunes／月之符文是 Symbolic Language／符號式語言，也是可獨立運作的 LunaRunes Scope。LunaRunes 不定義 LOC 的 Current 架構。

FAQ-091.answer: LOC／月典的現行正式身份固定為 Modular Language Framework／模組化語言框架；LunaRunes／月之符文固定為 Symbolic Language／符號式語言。Current 架構是 Scope Model × Feature Model → Page Composition。
